Yartemlea (narsoplimab-wuug) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-700339  
Guideline Name 
Yartemlea (narsoplimab-wuug)  
Formulary 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Yartemlea  
Approval Length 
16 Week(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of hematopoietic 
stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (TA-TMA)  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 2079 ===
Page 2079 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) including lab records collected within the 
past 30 days confirming ALL of the following:  
Platelet count less than 150 x 109//L  
Evidence of microangiopathic hemolysis (e.g., presence of schistocytes, serum lactate 
dehydrogenase (LDH) greater than or equal to two times the upper limit of normal, or 
haptoglobin less than the lower limit of normal)  
Renal dysfunction (i.e., doubling of serum creatinine from pretransplant)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is 2 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescriber attests that patient will not be using Yartemlea (narsoplimab-wuug) in 
combination with another complement inhibitor  
 
AND 
 
5 - Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a hematologist, oncologist, or stem cell transplant 
specialist  
 
AND 
 
6 - One of the following:  
If the patient weighs less than 50 kg: Dose does not exceed 4 mg/kg twice weekly  
If the patient weighs greater than or equal to 50 kg: Dose does not exceed 370 mg twice 
weekly  
Notes  
Note: Requests for patients under 2 years of age will be reviewed by 
AHCCCS FFS or MCO plan
